input.relationship: 提供一个双方属主能够采纳的兼容修改建议。src/cart.ts#Cart.total call src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount (forward)

evidence.reason: Call site applyDiscount(amount + 1, 0.1) passes only two arguments, but the merged applyDiscount signature requires a third currency: string argument.
Signature changed to applyDiscount(price: number, rate: number, currency: string), making currency required; existing two-argument callers in cart.ts and pricing.ts now fail.
Still calls applyDiscount(price, 0.1) with two arguments, which is incompatible with the new required currency parameter.
Still calls applyDiscount(price, 0.2) with two arguments, also incompatible with the new required currency parameter.
Test asserts cart.total() === 18, but the +1 change in Cart.total alters the computed total, so the test expectation no longer holds.
checkout passes cart.total() to formatMoney; the changed total value propagates to the checkout output asserted in tests.

result.userExplanation: 两处修改合并后会导致 applyDiscount 缺少必需的 currency 参数且购物车总价测试失败，必须协调修改调用方与签名。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount 的属主将 currency 参数改为可选（currency?: string）或提供默认值，并请 src/cart.ts#Cart.total 的属主在调用处补传 currency 参数、同时确认 +1 是否应保留以匹配测试期望的 18。
